_notes.vin_structure: 17 chars: pos1-3=WMI, pos4-8=VDS, pos9=check_digit, pos10=model_year, pos11=plant, pos12-17=serial
_notes.vds_market_split: CRITICAL — VW is the MOST distinctive in VDS approach. European-format VINs (most GCC vehicles): pos4-6 = 'ZZZ' filler (explicit ISO 3779 permission for unused positions), pos7 = model_line_code, pos8 = engine_type_code, pos9 = NOT check digit (often 0 or Z). US-format VINs (1VW/3VW): pos4-8 full NHTSA encoding, pos9 = NHTSA check digit.
_notes.gcc_note: Most UAE/GCC VW vehicles are WVW (German passenger cars) or WVG (German SUVs) — European format. ZZZ in pos4-6 carries NO vehicle data. For a UAE VIN intelligence platform, all VDS intelligence for GCC VWs comes ONLY from pos7 and pos8.
_notes.pr_codes_note: VW Group PR codes (Produktionsnummer) — 3-character codes on spare-wheel-well sticker — are the primary tool for full option/trim ID. E.g. 9AK = dual-zone climate, 1KW = electronic parking brake. FAR more granular than VIN. These are NOT in the VIN string.
_notes.check_digit_note: WVW/WVG/WV1/WV2 European VINs: pos9 is NOT NHTSA check digit. 1VW/3VW US/Mexico VINs: pos9 = NHTSA check digit.

WVW.notes: Golf/Polo/Passat/Arteon/ID.3/ID.7 from Wolfsburg, Emden, Zwickau, Dresden

3VW.notes: Jetta, Golf, Tiguan from Puebla; NHTSA-format VIN

AAV.notes: South African assembly — Polo, Polo Vivo, T-Cross

position_9._note: WVW/WVG/WV1/WV2 European-built: pos9 is NOT NHTSA check digit — often '0' or 'Z'. Do NOT run check digit validation on these. 1VW/3VW US/Mexico: NHTSA check digit applies.

position_11_plant.B: Brussels, Belgium (Golf Cabriolet legacy / Audi Q8 e-tron now)
position_11_plant.U: Uitenhage, South Africa (Polo/Polo Vivo — AAV WMI)

vds_format_detection._note: IF vin[3]+vin[4]+vin[5] == 'ZZZ' → use euro_format tables (all WVW/WVG/AAV GCC vehicles). ELSE → use us_format tables (1VW/3VW). This is the single most important check for VW VIN decoding.

euro_format._note: European-format VDS: pos4-6 = ZZZ (literal filler with no vehicle data). ALL GCC VW vehicles from Germany will have ZZZ here. Meaningful data ONLY in pos7 and pos8.

_pos_layout.pos7: Model line code — PRIMARY decode field
_pos_layout.pos8: Engine type code — PRIMARY decode field

position_7_model_line._note: Position 7 = vehicle model line. Most consistent VW position across both market formats. For European-format this is the ONLY model identifier.
position_7_model_line.A: Golf / Golf GTI / Golf R / Golf Cabrio

position_8_engine._note: Position 8 = engine family for European-format. Most common UAE codes: B (1.5L TSI), C (2.0L TSI EA888), D (2.0L TDI diesel). Z = BEV electric (ID family).
position_8_engine.C: 2.0L TSI (EA888 Gen.3) 4-cyl — Golf GTI/R, Tiguan, Passat
position_8_engine.D: 2.0L TDI (EA288) diesel — most popular European variant
position_8_engine.Z: Electric drivetrain — ID.3 / ID.4 / ID.5 / ID.7 BEV

us_format._note: US-format VDS for 1VW (USA) and 3VW (Mexico Puebla) vehicles. Full NHTSA encoding pos4-8.
